title: Customer prefix inactive — BGP next-hop not resolved in RIB
symptom: R2 shows the customer prefix 10.1.0.0/24 in the BGP table with an Established session to 192.0.2.2, but the prefix does not appear in the IP routing table and traffic is black-holed.

inject.note: Removes the connected or static route covering the eBGP peer subnet. BGP session stays up (TCP keepalives continue), but prefix 10.1.0.0/24 has an unreachable next-hop 192.0.2.2 and is marked inactive.

ground_truth.root_cause: BGP next-hop 192.0.2.2 not resolved in RIB on R2 — customer prefix 10.1.0.0/24 is inactive (next-hop unreachable)
ground_truth.fix: Restore the route to 192.0.2.0/31 (connected or static) so the BGP next-hop resolves
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp 10.1.0.0/24 shows prefix with valid next-hop and best-path flag set
